description: Surface typing injection errors upward (instead of swallowing them) and consolidate gemini.js session globals into an explicit state object with a reset function
steps: In src/typing/InjectionScheduler.js _scheduleNext method (around line 97), change the empty catch block to emit an 'injection-error' event: this.emit('injection-error', { error: e.message, backend: this._backend?.getName?.() || 'unknown', position: this._queue.getPosition() }); - keep the execution flowing (non-fatal).

In src/typing/TypingManager.js _createScheduler method, after creating the scheduler and setting up the 'complete' and 'injected' listeners, add: this._scheduler.on('injection-error', (detail) => { this.emit('injection-error', detail); });

In src/index.js where typing events are forwarded to renderer (after the typingManager event listeners around line 62), add: typingManager.on('injection-error', (detail) => sendToRenderer('typing-injection-error', detail));

In src/utils/renderer.js near the typing event listeners section (around line 1393), add a listener: ipcRenderer.on('typing-injection-error', (_, detail) => { showToast(`Typing error: ${detail.error} (${detail.backend})`); _eventBus.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('typing-injection-error', { detail })); });

In src/utils/gemini.js, group the scattered module-level session variables (currentSessionId, currentTranscription, conversationHistory, groqConversationHistory, screenAnalysisHistory, currentProfile, currentCustomPrompt, currentSystemPrompt) into a single _sessionState object.
Add a resetSessionState() function that resets all fields in _sessionState to their initial values (null, empty string, empty array as appropriate).
Update all existing references to these variables throughout gemini.js to use _sessionState.xxx instead.
Call resetSessionState() at the end of the closeSession/stopSession logic (wherever the session is torn down).
acceptance_criteria: InjectionScheduler emits 'injection-error' events instead of swallowing errors silently
Main process sends typing-injection-error to renderer when injection errors occur
Renderer shows a toast and dispatches an event bus event on injection error
gemini.js session variables are consolidated into _sessionState object
resetSessionState() exists and is called on session close
node --check passes on all modified files
findings: All references updated successfully. groqConversationHistory was at top-level scope (line 20), moved into _sessionState. resetSessionState() called in all three close-session paths (cloud, local, byok). No pre-existing test failures.
